summary: Risk sentiment is bearish today: hotter-than-expected inflation and renewed Federal Reserve rate concerns are pressuring Bitcoin, ether, XRP, equities, and other risk assets. Treasury buying has weakened the US dollar and lifted gold, while the available sources do not verify fresh same-day calls from the named crypto influencers for most requested tokens.
